name: Uthai
overview: Uthai is a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Ammihud. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture provides no additional notes about his life or role. His mention in 1 Chronicles 9:4 situates him within the broader context of the tribe of Judah's lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Uthai is a proper name that may mean either 'superiority of YHWH' or '[my] restoration,' reflecting possible theological themes of God's supremacy or renewal. This meaning is derived from the Hebrew roots associated with his name as recorded in 1 Chronicles 9:4.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Uthai is the son of Ammihud, establishing his immediate paternal lineage. No other family relationships are noted beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Uthai's significance lies primarily in his inclusion within the genealogical records of Judah, underscoring the importance of family lines in God's providential plan. His identification as Ammihud's son in 1 Chronicles 9:4 contributes to preserving the heritage of the tribe of Judah, which holds a central place in biblical history and prophecy.
